title: Derrick Henry: I haven't mentioned going somewhere else, let's try to get better

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Derrick Henry: I haven't mentioned going somewhere else, let's try to get better
sources.description: The Ravens got blown out for the third straight game on Thursday night and they lost their fourth straight overall, which led running back Derrick Henry to call it the "same story" after the Jaguars rolled to a 33-10 win in Baltimore.
